title: The Bit I Keep Coming Back To
gist_ar: حديث متقطّع عن اختيار مورّد: السعر مكانش السبب، والمتكلم بيوصل لده بالتدريج.

before_listening.en: He is trying to remember a meeting. Listen for what he decides actually settled it.
before_listening.ar: بيحاول يتذكّر اجتماع. ركّز على إيه اللي استنتج إنه حسم الموضوع.

segments.speaker: Committee member
segments.text: People keep telling me it was the price and it wasn't the price. Meridian were cheaper, yes, marginally, and the quality assessments came back equivalent, so on paper — I mean on paper you'd take Meridian. What I remember is Hala at the end of the table, and she'd been quiet for most of it, and she said something like, week fourteen against a week eleven deadline isn't a discount, it's a bill you haven't opened yet. Which stuck. It was then that the whole thing turned, I think, though nobody wrote it down that way. And there was the penalty clause. Castell agreed to one and Meridian wouldn't, and at the time that felt like a small procedural detail — it's the sort of thing you note and move past. Looking at it now it was the tell. A supplier who won't sign a penalty clause is telling you what they think their own chances are. Anyway, the minutes say 'delivery was decisive', which is true and tells you nothing, because delivery was decisive in a very specific way that took Hala one sentence to see and the rest of us forty minutes. What actually mattered, and I'd say this to anybody, is that the cheap option was cheap on the number we were looking at and expensive on the number we weren't. One more thing, since we're on it. I went back through my own notebook from that week and I'd written 'Meridian — cheaper?' with a question mark next to it, which tells you I half-saw it and didn't push. That's the part I'd change. Not the outcome. The outcome was right. The forty minutes it took us, when one person in the room had it in a sentence.

gist_question.q: What does he conclude actually settled the decision?
gist_question.q_ar: إيه اللي استنتج إنه حسم القرار؟
options: That the cheap option was expensive on a cost they were not looking at
The price difference between the suppliers

questions.q: What does he now think the penalty clause revealed?
questions.q_ar: بيفكّر دلوقتي إن شرط الغرامة كشف إيه؟
options: That Castell was significantly more expensive and knew it when they signed
What Meridian thought of their own chances

questions.q: Why does he say the minutes tell you nothing?
questions.q_ar: ليه بيقول إن المحضر مش بيقول حاجة؟
options: The minutes were never actually written up after the meeting had concluded
'Delivery was decisive' is true but omits how
She had a conflict of interest
She was overruled by the committee
She saw in one sentence what took the others forty minutes
